name: mtax-lua
description: Lua 5.4 tooling for MTAX resources: 1059 natives, 172 events, OOP API, manifest validation and resource scaffolding.

commands.title: New Script (adds it to the manifest)…
Open documentation for the symbol at the cursor
Set up lua-language-server for this workspace
Regenerate the API from local MTAX sources (developers)
Set the side of the current file (client / server / shared)

mtax.enable.description: Turn the whole MTAX language layer on or off.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language, falling back to English.
mtax.docsLanguage.description: Language used for hovers, completion details and signature help.

mtax.diagnostics.enable.description: Report MTAX problems in Lua files.

mtax.diagnostics.wrongSide.description: Severity for calling a server-only native from a client script, and the other way round.

mtax.diagnostics.sharedSideCalls.description: Severity for a one-sided native called from a shared script. Off by default: a shared script usually branches on localPlayer and calls each side from its own half.

mtax.diagnostics.typos.description: Severity for a called global that is one or two characters away from a real native (setElemenPosition → setElementPosition).

mtax.diagnostics.unknownNative.description: Severity for calling a function that is shaped like a native (outputChatBox, guiGetText, getPlayerMoney) but does not exist in MTAX and is defined nowhere in the resource. This is what a resource ported from MTA usually trips on.

mtax.diagnostics.sandbox.description: Severity for globals and libraries the MTAX sandbox removes (require, dofile, io, package, os.execute…).

mtax.diagnostics.manifest.description: Validate mtaxmanifest.lua the way the server does: path rules, the script/asset split, ui_page, exports.

mtax.diagnostics.deprecatedMeta.description: Point out meta.xml files sitting in a resource folder and offer to convert them.

mtax.completion.oop.description: Suggest the OOP API (Element, Player, Vehicle…) alongside the plain natives.

mtax.completion.snippets.description: Expand a native into a call with its arguments filled in as tab stops.

mtax.luals.autoConfigure.description: Point lua-language-server at the bundled MTAX definitions when an MTAX workspace is opened.

mtax.statusBar.description: Show which side the current file runs on in the status bar.

mtax.sourceRoot.description: Folder holding MTAX-Purple/ and wiki/, used by "Regenerate the API from local MTAX sources". Leave empty to search upwards from the workspace.

mtax.author.description: Name written to resource_author when a new resource is scaffolded. Empty falls back to the OS user name.
